name: What are the typical costs associated with a fixer-upper renovation in Las Vegas?

mainEntity.name: What are the typical costs associated with a fixer-upper renovation in Las Vegas?

acceptedAnswer.text: Renovation costs in Las Vegas vary widely depending on the scope of work. Minor cosmetic updates might start from $10,000 to $25,000. Mid-range renovations, including kitchen or bathroom remodels, could range from $45,000 to $90,000. Major structural changes or whole-home remodels often exceed $100,000. Factors influencing cost include materials, labor, permits, and the extent of changes to plumbing or electrical systems. We provide detailed estimates after an initial assessment.
acceptedAnswer.description: Typical fixer-upper renovation costs in Las Vegas range from $10,000 for minor updates to over $100,000 for major remodels, depending on scope and materials.
